deck: Who Killed Kenny - Creator's Base Deck
without_commander: Counter / stack: 7 in the library (e.g. Commit // Memory, Counterspell); Recurring draw: 3 in the library (e.g. Court of Grace, Teferi, Time Raveler).
commander_adds:
{R}: All creatures gain trample and haste until end of turn.
{1}{G}: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature.
{2}{W}: Target player gains 5 life.
{3}{U}: Target player draws a card.
{4}{B}: Put target creature card from a graveyard onto the battlefield under its owner's control.

without_commander: Deep Forest Hermit produces bodies and Fyndhorn Elves supplies mana. An existing board can pressure opponents or fund an expensive spell.
commander_adds: Affinity for creatures helps cast Witherbloom and then discounts instants and sorceries such as Army of the Damned. Losing the board makes that high end expensive again.

without_commander: Lord of Atlantis and Master of the Pearl Trident turn ordinary Merfolk into a threatening team; Harbinger of the Seas can make islandwalk relevant.
commander_adds: Blue symbols in your noncreature spells now produce Merfolk, and every Merfolk adds to Namor's power. A spell-heavy hand can still build a board.

without_commander: Felidar Retreat and Court of Grace build tokens independently; Anointed Procession rewards either source.
commander_adds: Suki converts your creature count into her own power and adds an attacking Ally whenever she attacks. Going wide can also threaten one player with commander damage.

without_commander: Arbor Elf and Circle of Dreams Druid accelerate creature deployment; Beast Whisperer can refill while you build toward Craterhoof Behemoth.
commander_adds: Yeva lets green creatures be cast at instant speed. The same mana can represent an answer during combat or an end-step threat if no answer is needed.
game_changers: Ancient Tomb; Chrome Mox; Crop Rotation; Mana Vault; Seedborn Muse; The One Ring; Worldly Tutor

without_commander: Counterspell and Beast Within answer threats while Guttersnipe converts instants and sorceries into damage around the table.
commander_adds: A tapped Kalamax copies the first instant you cast each turn, including opponents' turns. Copying instants also grows him into a combat threat.
game_changers: Ancient Tomb; Chrome Mox; Crop Rotation; Fierce Guardianship; Force of Will; Gamble; Mana Vault; Mystical Tutor; Seedborn Muse; The One Ring

leading_tribes: Wizard (7); Human (4); Advisor (2); Cat (2); Cleric (2); Elf (2); Spirit (2); Warlock (2)
without_commander: Archmage Emeritus draws off instants and sorceries, while Kambal, Consul of Allocation drains life on opposing noncreature casts.
commander_adds: Y'shtola turns your noncreature spells of mana value three or more into table damage and lifegain. If any player lost at least four life that turn, she draws at the end step.

without_commander: Even setting eminence aside, Blood Artist and Cruel Celebrant convert dying creatures into life swings. The sacrifice plan does not need Edgar on the battlefield.
commander_adds: Edgar already makes a token when you cast another Vampire from the command zone. Casting him adds an immediate hasty attack that can put a counter on every Vampire you control.

without_commander: Gemhide Sliver lets changelings make mana, and Cloudshredder Sliver gives them haste and flying. Those shared-type payoffs work without resolving the commander.
commander_adds: Eminence already discounts other Dragon spells, including changelings. Once on the field, attacking Dragons draw cards and can put a permanent from hand onto the battlefield.

without_commander: Deepglow Skate and Evolution Sage add counters to existing permanents, so the planeswalkers can build loyalty without Atraxa.
commander_adds: At your end step Atraxa proliferates across the board. She advances several walkers at once, but needs counters already in place.
game_changers: Cyclonic Rift; Narset, Parter of Veils

without_commander: Beetleback Chief supplies several bodies and Goblin Chieftain turns a small board into immediate pressure; Skirk Prospector can trade bodies for mana.
commander_adds: Krenko's tap ability makes a Goblin for each Goblin you control. Chieftain's haste lets him use it immediately, but an empty board limits the first activation.

without_commander: Goblin Electromancer discounts instants and sorceries, and Guttersnipe damages each opponent as you cast them. The spellslinger plan can run without Vivi.
commander_adds: Noncreature casts grow Vivi and ping the table. Once on your turn, Vivi converts that power into blue and/or red mana for another sequence of spells.
game_changers: Cyclonic Rift; Jeska's Will; Mystical Tutor; Rhystic Study

without_commander: Dunland Crebain builds an Army, and Mauhur, Uruk-hai Captain can increase its counters. Massacre Wurm can punish smaller opposing boards without an attack.
commander_adds: Opponents' spells repeatedly grow your Army. If it hits a player, the Ring tempts you and Sauron can exchange your hand for four cards.

without_commander: Hedron Crab stocks the graveyard. Life from the Loam retrieves lands for more landfall triggers, including Evolution Sage's proliferate.
commander_adds: Attacking mills three and can put a land from the graveyard onto the field. When one or more cards leave your graveyard, Teval also supplies a Zombie Druid.

without_commander: Faithless Looting can put a large threat in the graveyard for Reanimate; it need not wait for Kaalia or enough mana to hard-cast it.
commander_adds: An attack on an opponent can put an Angel, Demon or Dragon such as Avacyn straight from hand into combat. She need not connect, but she does need an eligible card in hand.
game_changers: Ancient Tomb; Chrome Mox; Demonic Tutor; Drannith Magistrate; Enlightened Tutor; Gamble; Imperial Seal; Jeska's Will; Mana Vault; Mox Diamond; Necropotence; Opposition Agent; Orcish Bowmasters; Smothering Tithe; Teferi's Protection; The One Ring; Vampiric Tutor

without_commander: Archmage Emeritus refills the hand from spells and Storm-Kiln Artist makes Treasure from instants and sorceries. Neither needs combat.
commander_adds: While attacking, Azula copies spells cast in that window; firebending helps pay for them. Holding an instant for combat can now be worth more than casting it immediately.
game_changers: Ancient Tomb; Demonic Tutor; Jeska's Will

without_commander: Malcolm, Keen-Eyed Navigator and Breeches, Brazen Plunderer turn Pirate combat damage into Treasure and access to opposing cards.
commander_adds: Admiral Brass mills four on entry and can bring a Pirate back at the beginning of your combat as a hasty 4/4. The graveyard becomes a second source of attackers.

without_commander: Blood Artist and Cruel Celebrant reward creatures dying, so sacrifice and combat trades advance the game without the commander.
commander_adds: Clavileño marks an attacking non-Demon Vampire. When that creature later dies, it draws a card and leaves a tapped flying 4/3 behind.

without_commander: Master of the Pearl Trident boosts Merfolk and Seafloor Oracle rewards combat damage with cards. A wide board already has a way to pay off.
commander_adds: Hakbal makes each of your Merfolk explore at the beginning of your combat. Attacking with Hakbal adds another choice: put a land from hand onto the field or draw.

without_commander: Regisaur Alpha adds a Dinosaur and grants other Dinosaurs haste. Return of the Wildspeaker can turn a large non-Human into a fresh hand.
commander_adds: Pantlaza can discover from a Dinosaur's toughness when it enters, once each turn. More large bodies can therefore mean another spell without paying its mana cost.
